# MSI extension regional correction — SRC-0276

## Source

https://de-store.msi.com/products/1yr-warranty-extension_notebook

The €119 one-year notebook extension found previously is sold by MSI Germany, is currently shown unavailable and its terms restrict that store transaction to a German/same-country purchase. The €119 price cannot be attached to Belgian `B2WI-035BE` or `B2WJ-039BE` pricing, so the former €4281.04 RTX 5090 calculation remains retracted. This correction does not invalidate the service code itself: `SRC-0282` later found `957-1XXXXE-073` live at a Belgian retailer for €162.62.

This does not prove that Belgian MSI extensions do not exist. It proves only that no exact purchasable Belgian third-year product has yet been established. A Belgian retailer or MSI must provide a written priced route covering normal-use cooling defects before either Raider clears the support gate.
